context: Theorem 1 we get that (δn)-Coloring can be solved in O∗ (2(1−(δ−1/3)n ) time. Using very different techniques, previous work showed that for δ ∈ [0, 1] it is possible to distinguish between the cases where the input graph G admits a proper coloring with (δn − 1) colors 4 and the case where any proper coloring of G needs at least (δn + 1) colors in O∗ (2(1−Ω(δ ))n ) time [21, Theorem 1.2].
